# Hakim Olamaz

> Regent of the Ashgrove Chantry and the Tremere seat on the Primogen. He does not want the Princedom; he wants to pick who gets it.

## Appearance

A tall, grey-templed man who looks fifty and dresses like a university librarian. He is never seen without a small leather notebook and never seen writing in it.

## Personality

Patient to the point of cruelty. Hakim asks questions he already knows the answers to, in order to find out who lies. He is unfailingly polite to neonates, which frightens them more than rudeness would.

## Role in Campaign 1

- Votes last on the Primogen and has never explained a vote.
- Quietly funds the hunter cell's informant, to keep the hunters pointed away from the chantry.
- Knows the Fenwick Street tunnels are wrong. Wants to know what is down there before anyone else does.
- A Tremere player character is his apprentice whether they like it or not.

## Stats (summary)

Seventh generation; trait maximum 6, blood pool 20, spends up to 4 blood per turn. Thaumaturgy 5 (Path of Blood), Auspex 4, Dominate 3. Willpower 9, Humanity 5. He does not fight if he can avoid it, and he can usually avoid it.
